description: Search live job listings by free text and return up to 10 matching jobs, most relevant first, each with its id, a title line (job title, company, location) and URL. Pass the id of any result to `fetch` to read the full listing. For structured filtering (location, salary, seniority, remote-only, specific ATS) or a different number of results, prefer `search_jobs`. Billed per job returned: the plan's included jobs are used first, then the account's wallet. A search that returns no jobs costs nothing. One call returns, and bills, at most 10 jobs; with `search_jobs`, keep `page_size` as small as the question needs.

query.description: What to search for, e.g. 'senior rust engineer remote europe'.
